## Summary

- **`reponeedle_inspect`** — Returned repository metadata: 11 indexed files across the `shopcart` package, its tests, and config files. Also reported available rankers (`arm101`, `bm25`, `cascade`, `change_impact`, `legacy`) and confirmed the index was initialized successfully.

- **`reponeedle_retrieve`** — Answered a natural-language query about discount logic. It correctly surfaced the test files and implementation files most relevant to discounts (top hits: `test_cart.py`, `test_checkout.py`, `cart.py`, `checkout.py`, `test_pricing.py`), all within the 2000-token budget (used 1262 tokens).

- **`reponeedle_change_impact`** — Identified that modifying `shopcart/pricing.py` would most directly affect `shopcart/cart.py`, `tests/test_pricing.py`, and `shopcart/checkout.py` (all confirmed via AST import analysis). The anchor file itself was suppressed via Seed File Suppression. Sibling files and test files were also flagged at lower confidence.
